staff.title: Team access
staff.elevate: Verify security key for team access
staff.confirm: I confirm this exact target and change
staff.registerHint: A fresh password and authenticator check permits key registration only. It does not grant team access.
staff.recovery: Recovery uses a replacement account, one verified key (which may be new) and offline material. Additional keys are optional. The old account stays on security hold; its private debates stay with it. Password or authenticator codes cannot replace the key proofs.
staff.unavailable: Team tools are temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
staff.failed: The action could not be completed. Refresh and review the details before trying again.
staff.denied: Your team session has ended. Verify your security key again.
staff.locked: Team tools are locked. The operator can unlock them for one hour at a time.
staff.signIn: Sign in to check account readiness.
staff.webauthn: Security key verification unavailable or cancelled. Try again with your verified key.
staff.stale: Revision changed. Current data has been refreshed; review and confirm a new operation.
staff.possessionHint: Use the prepared command and its privately supplied nonce and the selected verified public credential ID. A second ID is needed only if that command selected two keys. This records possession receipts only.
staff.keyTwo: Second selected public credential ID (only for a two-key command)
staff.possessed: Possession receipts recorded. The independent operator must complete the prepared command.
staff.reopenSignedIn: Sign in, then reopen the original invitation link from your email. The invitation is not saved in this browser.
staff.acceptHint: Acceptance checks the current invitation revision with the server and requires your verified security key. It creates no staff session.
staff.acceptFailed: Invitation has not been accepted. It may be pending, disabled, expired or unavailable. Reopen the original link after checking readiness.
staff.accepted: Invitation accepted. Verify your security key separately on the team page to obtain team access.
staff.receiptsHint: Pass these recorded receipt IDs to the independent operator before their expiry. A partial result does not complete the prepared command.
staff.intro: Manage team access and security activity with your verified security key.
staff.unlockHint: Verify your security key to see the access available to you.
staff.notReady: Check your account, verified email and authenticator before continuing.
staff.addKeyHint: Register an additional key using your verified team access.
staff.membersHint: Review members and the permissions assigned to them.
staff.targetHint: Use the exact account ID shared by the recipient from their account details.
staff.targetStaffHint: The Staff ID shown under Member details.
staff.help.invite: Choose permissions for this account. Your security key confirms the invitation.
staff.help.grant: Choose the permissions this member should keep. Your security key confirms the change.
staff.help.disable: Remove this member’s team access for offboarding. Your security key confirms the change.
staff.help.compromise: Disable team access after a suspected compromise. Review the selected member before confirming with your security key.
staff.advancedHint: Use these options when setting up a security key or completing a prepared recovery.
staff.reviews.heading: Publication reviews
staff.reviews.empty: No debates are waiting for review.
staff.reviews.category.SUICIDE_OR_HARM_T: tendencies to suicide or harming other people
staff.reviews.error.notFound: This request is not available. It may already be decided, or the debate was deleted.
staff.reviews.error.ownDebate: You cannot review a debate that your own account owns.
staff.reviews.error.sameReviewer: You refused this debate before. Another reviewer must decide.
staff.reviews.error.decided: This request has already been decided.
staff.reviews.error.locked: Team tools are locked until the team's security alert is ready.
staff.reviews.error.noPermission: Your account does not have the Publication reviews permission.
staff.reviews.notElevated: Sign in to the team console first.
staff.threatReports.title: Threat reports
staff.threatReports.lede: Questions our automatic check refused and kept because they may threaten someone. Read each one and record whether you reported it to the authorities.
staff.threatReports.empty: No threat report is waiting to be read.
staff.threatReports.decideHint: Reported: you have told the competent authorities. Not reported: you found no credible threat, and the report is erased at once. Each decision asks for your security key.
staff.threatReports.noAccess: You don't have access to threat reports.
staff.threatReports.gone: This report no longer exists: it was erased, or another team member recorded it as not reported.
staff.threatReports.alreadyDecided: Another team member already recorded a decision on this report. This is its current state.
staff.threatReports.loadFailed: Threat reports could not be loaded. Go back and try again.
staff.threatReports.verifyFirst: Verify Team access first to read threat reports.
staff.teamLimit.title: The team's limit
staff.teamLimit.noLimit: No team limit is set, so the team has no room this month. New team questions wait until one is set.
staff.teamLimit.passkey: You will be asked for your passkey.
staff.teamLimit.invalidAmount: Write an amount in dollars, like 20 or 12.50.
staff.teamLimit.stale: Someone changed this a moment ago. Look at the new value and try again.
staff.teamLimit.partnerExists: Someone already holds this. To pick someone else, take it back first.
staff.teamLimit.locked: Team tools are locked, so this can't be changed right now.
staff.teamLimit.failed: This did not go through. Look at the values here and try again.
staff.teamLimit.partner.title: The person who shares this with the Owner
staff.teamLimit.partner.onlyOne: To pick someone else, take it back first.
staff.teamLimit.partner.nobody: There is nobody on the team to pick yet.
staff.teamLimit.partner.confirmPick: Let {name} see and change the team's limit too?
staff.teamLimit.practice.title: Add a practice's charge
staff.teamLimit.practice.hint: The practice tool prints both of these.
staff.teamLimit.practice.confirm: Add {amount} to this month's spending, for practice {ref}?
staff.teamLimit.practice.invalidRef: This practice reference is not right. Copy it exactly as the practice tool printed it.
staff.teamLimit.log.title: What changed
staff.teamLimit.log.practice: A practice's charge of {amount} was added.
staff.teamLimit.log.takenBack.OWNER_REVO: The Owner took it back from {name}.
staff.teamLimit.log.takenBack.STAFF_DISA: It ended for {name} because their team access ended.
staff.teamLimit.log.takenBack.ACCOUNT_ER: It ended for {name} because their account was erased.
staff.teamLimit.log.takenBack.OWNER_CHAN: It ended for {name} because the Owner changed.
staff.teamLimit.notice.FAILED: The email about this could not be sent. The change stands.
staff.teamAllowance.title: Quotas for team members
staff.teamAllowance.hint: Give a team member their own amount for debates with all the top features. What they spend counts in the team's month too. Only you can do this.
staff.teamAllowance.line: Spent {spent} of {amount}. Up to {day} a day and {week} a week. Ends on {ends}.
staff.teamAllowance.nobody: Everyone on the team already has a quota.
staff.teamAllowance.day: Most in one day, in dollars
staff.teamAllowance.week: Most in one week, in dollars
staff.teamAllowance.most: The most you can give: {amount} in total, {day} a day, {week} a week, for {days} days.
staff.teamAllowance.confirmGive: Give {name} {amount} in total, up to {day} a day and {week} a week, for {days} days?
staff.teamAllowance.confirmTakeBack: Take back {name}'s quota? Their next debates go back to their normal plan.
staff.teamAllowance.passkey: Your passkey confirms this. It goes in the log nobody can edit, and you and the person both get an email.
staff.teamAllowance.invalidAmount: Write each amount in dollars, like 20 or 12.50.
staff.teamAllowance.outOfOrder: A day can't be more than a week, and a week can't be more than the total.
staff.teamAllowance.tooMuch: That is more than you can give. The most is written above.
staff.teamAllowance.invalidDays: Write a whole number of days, within the most written above.
staff.teamAllowance.stale: This changed a moment ago. Look at the new value and try again.
staff.teamAllowance.exists: This person already has a quota. Take it back first.
staff.teamAllowance.unavailable: This person can't receive a quota right now: they may have left the team, or their account is on hold.
staff.teamAllowance.locked: Team tools are locked for now. Nothing changed.
staff.teamAllowance.failed: That did not work. Nothing changed.
staff.teamAllowance.log.title: What changed
staff.teamAllowance.log.given: {name} was given {amount}, up to {day} a day and {week} a week
staff.teamAllowance.log.ended.STAFF_DISA: {name}'s quota ended: they left the team or were disabled
staff.teamAllowance.log.ended.ACCOUNT_ER: {name}'s quota ended: the account was erased
staff.teamAllowance.log.ended.OWNER_CHAN: {name}'s quota ended: the Owner changed, so the new Owner gives again
staff.teamAllowance.notice.WAITING: The email is on its way
staff.teamAllowance.notice.FAILED: The email about this could not be sent. The change stands.
staff.publicReview.failure.PUBLIC_REVIEW: Someone else took a step first. Here is the debate as it is now; look again and try once more.
Hide the debate first. Corrections happen only while it is hidden.
No public debate has that link.
That piece cannot take this step.
staff.publicReview.failure.STAFF_ALERT_U: Team tools are locked, so only hiding works now. Everything else waits until they are back.
staff.publicReview.failure.STAFF_INPUT_I: The page could not read that text. Check it and try again.
staff.publicReview.failure.PUBLIC_REVIEW: The reason is not complete, or that report is not about this debate. Choose a rule, where the facts came from and write the facts.
staff.publicReview.ground.optional: A hide never waits for this. If you already know which rule it may break, or which report led here, say so; the author is told the debate is hidden while we review it.
staff.publicReview.ground.needed: The person concerned gets a statement of reasons from this. Choose at least one rule, where the facts came from, and write the facts.
staff.publicReview.ground.WEAPONS_OR_DRU: Terms §7: instructions for crafting weapons or drugs
staff.publicReview.ground.SUICIDE_OR_HAR: Terms §7: content encouraging suicide or harming other people
staff.publicReview.ground.PERSONAL_DATA: Terms §7: personal data about other people
staff.publicReview.ground.ILLEGAL: Illegal under the law (name the law in the facts)
staff.publicReview.source.REPORT_BUTTON: A report made with the Report button
staff.publicReview.facts: The facts: what you read, where, and why it breaks the rule. The person concerned reads this on their statement, so never name the person who reported it.
staff.publicReview.confirm.decide: Record the final decision: this debate stays hidden. Its author gets a statement of reasons with the rule and your facts.
staff.publicReview.failure.passkeyCancel: The passkey was cancelled. Nothing changed.
staff.publicReview.failure.other: That did not work. Nothing changed.
staff.publicReview.action.PUT_BACK: Put a piece back on the page
staff.publicReview.state.ITS_DIG_REMOVED: Off the page: its dig was taken out
staff.publicReview.state.AFFECTED: Affected: written after a dig that was taken out, so it stays off the page until you read it and put it back
staff.publicReview.done: Done. It is in the log, and both of you get an email that names nothing.
staff.publicReview.confirm.correct: Replace this text. The original stays sealed, for the two of you only.
staff.publicReview.passkeyConfirms: Your passkey confirms this one step.
staff.publicReview.title: Public debates under review
staff.publicReview.hint: For a removal order or a report: hide a debate at once. It stays hidden until one of you puts it back. Hiding needs no money and no check, and works even while team tools are locked.
staff.publicReview.isHidden: Hidden. Visitors see only a line that it is under review; no dig or report can start.
staff.publicReview.isPublic: Public. Anyone can read it now.
staff.publicReview.confirm.republish: Put this debate back on the site, with the corrected text. Digs and reports can start again. If anything was changed, the page says "Part of this debate was changed after review", with no reason.
staff.publicReview.confirm.hide: Hide this debate now, from every public page. A dig running on it finishes as its person's own and never changes the page.
staff.publicReview.snapshotUnreadable: The first snapshot could not be opened.
staff.publicReview.digs: Digs, each with what it changed
staff.publicReview.noDigs: No dig has changed this debate.
staff.publicReview.confirm.removeDig: Take this dig off the page. What was written after it also leaves the page until you read it and put it back. {who} sees that it was removed after review, with no staff name. This cannot be undone here.
staff.publicReview.confirm.putBackUpdate: Put this piece back on the page. You have read it and it does not repeat what was taken out.
staff.publicReview.confirm.hideReport: Hide this report version. This cannot be undone here.
staff.publicReview.confirm.putBackReport: Put this report back on the page. You have read it and it does not repeat what was taken out.
staff.publicReports.title: Reports from the Report button
staff.publicReports.hint: Reports waiting for a person, newest first. The reporter's name is for the two of you only, and each time this list is read it is logged.
staff.publicReports.byGone: By someone whose account is gone
staff.publicReports.wordsGone: The words of this report were deleted six months after it closed.
staff.publicReports.state.HIDDEN: The automatic check agreed: the debate was hidden automatically.
staff.publicReports.state.CHECKING: The check did not finish: for a person to read.
staff.publicReports.state.NOT_FOUND: The automatic check did not find this. Nothing was hidden.
staff.publicReports.verdict.NOT_FOUND: The AI did not find it.
staff.publicReports.verdict.none: The AI did not read this one.
staff.publicReports.reason.CONTENT: Reason: it breaks the content rules.
staff.publicReports.confirmNoBreach: Close this report as no breach found. The debate stays as it is. The reporter is told by email, with the routes to challenge it. This goes in the log.
staff.publicReports.confirmActed: Close this report as acted on. Take the step in the review tool first. The reporter is told by email that a person acted on it, with no detail. This goes in the log.
staff.publicReports.done: Done. It is in the log.
staff.publicReports.failed: That did not work. Nothing changed.
staff.publicReview.longHidden: Hidden for over 6 months. Its text is not deleted until you correct or remove it, so decide: put it back or take parts out.
